Jack Black, You Can’t Win.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jack-black/you-cant-win

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Jack Black, the author, died 1933 (Wikidata Q16066748). Citizenship: United States.

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'You Can’t Win was published in 1926 by Jack Black.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: works published before 1931 are in the public domain in the United States. The colophon dates this work to 1926. The edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the same.
- Country of origin (not stated by the colophon): the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life plus 70 years or less for this death, so the text is public domain in each of them by 1 January 1 January 2004. The last person to die among the people whose words are in the text is Jack Black, in 1933.
